reviews.title: Carnival rewards
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing three years and the Carnivals are incredibly boring anymore. 

The free rewards are just keys and Royal Tokens. I remember in the past you could win gear, skill points, pet points, etc. 

Also the Carnival activities are the same every single week. No mixing things up. I haven’t seen a Carnival Greenie in MONTHS. Probably a year by now. 

Some weeks I don’t even bother finishing because the main reward is Epic Gear and who wants Epic Gear when tourney is basically over? Your gear should be picked and upgraded by Monday night since everything resets Tuesday morning. When the main reward is gear, I will accept it to sell it. 

So incredibly disappointing.

reviews.title: Great for F2P
reviews.text:
Notes:
I’m only a little over halfway through campaign
If this is a game you want to sit and play for hours at a time, probably not for you
As far as what’s out there in the mobile gaming world, this is one of FEW games that’s actually remained on my phone longer than a day (well over a month now)
Pros:
Satisfying creating builds around your current gear/skills/pets
Easy to advance without spending $$
No forced ads
No annoying amount of optional ads
If you don’t like the reward for an ad, simply say no thanks Tom Hanks and don’t watch, you still get some coins for it
I quite like the fact you need “mint” or new gear for each week’s tournament. 
When you run out of keys (energy essentially) there’s still stuff to do
If you’re busy and your key stash gets full, you can burn them all in seconds quick clearing previous stages, still racking up coins, xp, and gear 

Cons:
Global chat needed, if your clan doesn’t chat, game feels like a ghost town
Need more activities/events/rewards for clan interaction
PvP needs some love
Tooltips/info in general could use a lot more detail

This game is preeeeetty old. I’d love to see a 3.

reviews.title: 6 years and this is what you have?
reviews.text: I’m baffled that after six years the PVP is absolutely awful. It’s the “2.0” version so clearly this is meant to be an improvement on the previous system. Zero balance, I’m constantly matched with people who have 5x the power I do and one shot me. Spend more time testing your game and less worrying about your ripoff $20/week money grab of a pass that forces the worst PVP I’ve ever seen in a game. Slow clap for the devs. Maybe in another six years you will understand what balance is.

reviews.title: Very good game
reviews.text: I only played for a month. This is one of few games that I come of across that is truly not PtW. This game thrives itself on “minting” cycle. Mint items are required to participate tournament events where you can earn rewards. Also mint items give extra bonuses in other events. You can earn mint items in dungeon and conquest runs. A mint cycle end after 7 days. All items that you earn during that cycle become non-mint. You have to earn new mint items or you can spend premium gems or tournament vouchers to buy item chest or buy Mint to remint one of your old item. Of course, it is impossible to be #1 without spending money. But I can do well without spending any money. I have a full set of good legendary. When the new cycle started, I can get another set of legendary. People on the Discord are very supportive. The only that I didn’t give 5 stars is because the game updates very slow. Nothing new since I started playing it.

reviews.title: Still the best game out there!
reviews.text:
I started playing this game over 5 yrs ago, and NEVER thought I would be playing it this long! Even after all this time, the game has a loyal community for a REASON! If you’re looking for a game with an interesting mechanic, one that actually requires skill to be good at, or one that isn’t just another gem matching game, I would HIGHLY recommend that you check out NSK2! 

Certainly no game is perfect, but DEFINITELY give this one a chance! And once you do, head over to the game’s discord where you’ll find some of the most passionate, helpful, and welcoming players that want to help out and show you how to be the best nonstopping knight you can be!
